On 24 August 2023, the power plant started releasing the treated portion of its wastewater into the Pacific Ocean.
At the time, its storage units held over a million tonnes of wastewater in total.

Because new wastewater is constantly being formed and even treated water must be discharged slowly by diluting it with more sea water, the entire process could take more than 30 years.[14] The decision to release this water into the ocean has faced concerns and criticism from other countries and international organisations.
